pages.title: Fractal Core
pages.text: The smallest copy of a Fractal Wyrm. It is also the largest.
Dropped by the $(thing)Fractal Wyrm$() of the Platonic Realm, a serpent made of smaller copies of itself. The smallest copy is the core.
Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Fractal Wyrm.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Liquid Antihelium, Stellar Singularity.
